details.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'web-mcp-assistant'; Write-Output ('ROOT='+$root); Get-Item (Join-Path $root 'runtime-supervisor-request.json'),(Join-Path $root 'runtime-supervisor-request.json.processing') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; $log=Join-Path $root 'logs\assistant.log'; if(Test-Path $log){ Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'restart-g18oPUDI7H3uhJuM|supervisor-restart-request|restart supervisor' -SimpleMatch:$fal
